worldcombat.skill.powershift.summary: The user swaps its Attack and Defence values for a visible window and swaps them back when it ends. With high Attack and low Defence it becomes the tank; with high Defence and low Attack it becomes the striker. It changes no stat stages, only trades the two values you already have.
worldcombat.skill.powershift.use.0: Swap to brace a round when Attack is high and Defence low
worldcombat.skill.powershift.use.1: Swap to strike when Defence is high and Attack low
worldcombat.skill.powershift.use.2: Pick a form once the opponent's plan is known
worldcombat.skill.powershift.description: Casting exchanges your Attack and Defence values for %1$s; you fight with the swapped values until the window runs out or is cleared, and then they return. No stat stages change - only the two values you already have.
worldcombat.skill.powershift.hold.on: Hold: the swap window is multiplied by 1.8, keeping the shifted form longer, at the cost of a 3-tick longer wind-up and 1.3x cooldown - and you cannot swap back meanwhile.
worldcombat.skill.powershift.hold.off: Snap: fast to cast, short cooldown and you can swap straight back, but it only covers a moment.
worldcombat.skill.powershift.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.powershift.growth.0: At level %1$s the swap window stretches to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.powershift.growth.1: At level %1$s the swap window stretches further to %2$s.
On: the swap window is multiplied by 1.8, at the cost of a 3-tick longer wind-up and 1.3x cooldown, and you cannot swap back meanwhile. Off: snap, fast with a short cooldown and an immediate swap back.
The move is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means swapping earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight on instead of swapping; larger gives up the swap more often up close.
The move is skipped unless the Attack/Defence ratio (higher over lower) reaches this; raising it only shifts on extreme attackers or defenders, avoiding pointless back-and-forth.
A health ratio below this counts as low: with high Attack and low Defence it shifts into the defensive form. Raising it shifts to defence earlier; lowering it waits until near death.
world_combat.move.powershift.text.invali: These two strengths cannot be traded
